content: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
author: Aristotle
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Across his life and work, Aristotle saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: What long-held assumption about your life or abilities is challenged by this insight?
